subject: Civil Engineering
title: Shear Force: The Sliding Danger
description: A quick win: understand Shear Force: The Sliding Danger.

hook.text: Scissors cut paper by pushing two blades past each other. That's shear force.

buildup.text: In structures, shear happens when forces push opposite sides in different directions.

discovery.text: Beams near their supports face the highest shear — the load tries to slide them apart.

twist.text: Shear failure is sudden with no warning — the material just snaps in two.

climax.text: Engineers add stirrups inside concrete beams to catch shear before it starts.

punchline.text: Shear is invisible until it's catastrophic.

quiz.question: Where do beams experience the highest shear force?
options: At the center of the span
Near the supports at each end
At the top surface of the beam
